visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a hand gripping a large pink wrapping paper. A young boy wearing a yellow and grey t-shirt looks up with wide, expectant eyes and a bright smile. The background is a crowded indoor hall with people holding various bouquets, under bright ceiling lights. (2) The camera pans as the boy walks along a red carpeted floor. He is presented with a massive bouquet wrapped in pink and blue, featuring a large blue Stitch plush toy at the center surrounded by various colorful snack bags and sunflowers. He laughs and looks around at the onlookers. (3) The boy stands on a wooden stage in front of a colorful backdrop decorated with hot air balloon graphics and Chinese text. A woman in a grey sleeveless dress helps him hold the giant bouquet as they pose for photos. The lighting is consistent and bright, typical of a school auditorium. (4) The boy interacts excitedly with the camera, pointing at the snacks and the Stitch toy in his arms. He makes energetic facial expressions, including sticking his tongue out in joy. Other children in graduation gowns and parents with cameras are visible in the blurred background.
